sentence: This project studies how mitochondrial network dynamics relate to abnormal vascular reactivity in the lungs of children born with congenital heart defects.
This project develops an imaging tool to assess the composition and vulnerability of atherosclerotic plaque in the vessel wall.
This project provides shared laboratories that help cancer researchers screen compounds and improve drug candidates before clinical trials.
This project develops noninvasive measures for diagnosis and response-assessment of brain cancer, and cellular immunotherapy for brain cancer.
This project studies how transcription factors change the epigenetic landscape and promote retinal ganglion cell differentiation.
This project builds mass spectrometry tools to map molecules in the brains of mouse models of Alzheimer's Disease and healthy control mice.
This project develops deep learning methods that improve patient representations and combine them with other health determinants to predict clinical risk.
This project studies a ubiquitin-independent pathway that degrades proteins, possibly misfolded or oxidatively-damaged proteins.
This project develops imaging tools to track disease progression and identifies treatments for calcific aortic stenosis.
This project studies how intrinsic and environmental signals affect the function and survival of human pancreatic β cells during type 1 diabetes progression.
This project studies how amyloid precursor protein overexpression affects cortical malformation and Alzheimer's disease in Down syndrome, using induced pluripotent stem cells.
This project tries to find out which cell types and circuits are active in the nucleus accumbens during opioid taking and seeking.
This project uses machine learning to study patterns of disease progression in hippocampal-cortical networks and to find neurobiological subtypes of schizophrenia.
This project tests engineered extracellular vesicles as cancer therapy in mouse clinical trials and works to standardize how they are produced.
This project studies how a type of white blood cell and a granzyme protein activate the complement pathway that drives inflammation.
This project uses natural language processing to turn free-text clinical evidence in biomedical literature into a computable format for extraction and summarization.
This project studies how mutations in a histone change transcriptional regulatory patterns in high-grade glioma, a brain tumor of the cerebral cortex.
This project builds automated tools to curate public genetic data and tests what predicts viral spillover among wild mammals and wild rodent populations.
This project studies how a receptor important for learning and memory changes in prefrontal circuits during aging in a non-human primate model.
This project provides high-throughput chemical and high-content screens and instruments that help researchers find molecular targets and small molecules for drug discovery.
